subject: Future Tech
title: Superalignment: OpenAI's Bet
description: Learn Superalignment: OpenAI's Bet in one minute.

hook.text: OpenAI created a Superalignment team to solve the problem of aligning superintelligent AI.

buildup.text: The idea: use current AI to supervise more powerful AI.

discovery.text: Early results showed AI can catch mistakes in smarter AI's outputs.

twist.text: The Superalignment team imploded in 2024. Key researchers quit, citing safety concerns being deprioritized.

climax.text: Alignment research continues across many labs.

punchline.text: Aligning AI is hard. Aligning the people building AI might be harder.

quiz.question: What was OpenAI's Superalignment approach?
options: Using weaker AI to supervise and align stronger AI
